name: arsin-print-server
description: Browser-based installer + wireless print server firmware for ESP32 / ESP8266 / Raspberry Pi

scripts.check:firmware: node firmware/tools/check-sources.mjs && node firmware/tools/check-syntax.mjs && node firmware/tools/check-assets.mjs && node firmware/tools/check-print-streaming.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:web-assets && npm run build:manifests
